entries.subject: fix: Correct stride calculation in AffineRank2RowMajor::packed() (#3048)
entries.message:
fix: Correct stride calculation in AffineRank2RowMajor::packed() (#3048)

The packed() method was returning AffineRank2RowMajor(1, extent.row()),
which sets row_stride=1 and column_stride=num_rows — identical to the
column-major version. For a tightly packed row-major layout, columns
should be contiguous (stride=1) and rows should be strided by the
number of columns.

Fixed to return AffineRank2RowMajor(extent.column(), 1), which is
consistent with the single-argument constructor and the
Affine2Layout_Factory specialization.

Fixes #2991

Signed-off-by: Blake Ledden <bledden@users.noreply.github.com>

entries.subject: Fix ScaledBasis equality for mismatched bases, add SM120 sparse metadata K assert (#3427)
entries.message:
Fix ScaledBasis equality for mismatched bases, add SM120 sparse metadata K assert (#3427)

cute::operator==(ScaledBasis, ScaledBasis) formed t.value() == u.value()
even when the basis IDs differ, so comparing two ScaledBasis whose value
types are not comparable failed to compile instead of returning false.
Form the value comparison only when the bases match.

That unblocks the SM120 block-scaled sparse 256x128x256 tile. Its
metadata tensor is tiled into a rank-2 M mode, and coalescing that mode
reaches the comparison with an int32_t value against a cute::R<1,16>.

The same collective asserts that the metadata atom divides the tile
along M but not along K, so an unsupported K tile is reported first as a
tile_to_shape failure inside cute. Add the K assert and move both above
the layout they constrain.

Signed-off-by: David Kogan <davidkny22@gmail.com>

entries.subject: Fix host compilation of cute::cast_smem_ptr_to_uint. (#940)
entries.message:
Fix host compilation of cute::cast_smem_ptr_to_uint. (#940)

* Remove references to device-only intrinsics when compiling for host.

Currently, we attempt to use the `__device__`-only functions
`__cvta_generic_to_shared` and `__nvvm_get_smem_pointer` when compiling
`cute::cast_smem_ptr_to_uint` for the host on Clang. This results in a
compilation error, as expected. This commit changes the definition of
the `*_ACTIVATED` macros so that they are only true when `__CUDA_ARCH__`
is defined; that is, when compiling for the device.

Additionally, the declaration of `__nvvm_get_smem_pointer`
is currently only visible during the device compilation pass when
compiling with NVCC; this commit makes the declaration visible during
host compilation with the `__device__` annotation.

* Annotate cute::cast_smem_ptr_to_uint as device-only.

The implementation of `cute::cast_smem_ptr_to_uint` is currently an
unchecked failure on host code, and the only host implementation I can
think of -- casting a probably-64-bit pointer to 32 bits somehow --
doesn't make sense to implement. This commit marks this function as
device-only so that it can't be accidentally used on host code.

* small change

entries.subject: Remove undefined behavior from default constructor of PredicatedTileAccessIteratorParams. (#1258)
entries.message:
Remove undefined behavior from default constructor of PredicatedTileAccessIteratorParams. (#1258)

Currently, the default constructor of
`PredicatedTileAccessIteratorParams` will invoke undefined behavior in
its invocation of the `initialize` function. Specifically, it will
attempt to read from the uninitialized variables
`desc.element_size_bits` and `desc.advance_rank`. This commit changes
the default constructors of both `*Params` and `*Desc` to
zero-initialize all uninitialized members.
